ability.kindredspirits.swift_step.desc: Quickens your pace while your companion is close.
Slowly knits your wounds back together.
ability.kindredspirits.night_ward.desc: Smothers flames that catch on you in cool shadow.
ability.kindredspirits.kindled_vigour.de: Your companion recovers its own health over time.
ability.kindredspirits.shadow_ball.desc: Hurls a spirit flame at your companion's target, leaving it adrift.
ability.kindredspirits.savage_leap.desc: Pounces onto its quarry, slamming down on everything around it.
ability.kindredspirits.crushing_might.de: Its heavy tread loosens stone, quickening your hands.
ability.kindredspirits.mirror_strike.des: Echoes a quarter of every blow you land on whatever you hit.
ability.kindredspirits.dragon_breath.des: Scorches its quarry with a gout of flame and leaves it burning.
ability.kindredspirits.forge_draft.desc: Fans nearby furnaces, smelting at twice the pace while it rests beside them.
ability.kindredspirits.alpha.desc: Its presence keeps monsters from spawning nearby, further with every level.
ability.kindredspirits.alpha_boost.desc: Strikes 15% harder for its bond with you.
ability.kindredspirits.xray_stomp.desc: Stomps and sends a pulse through the ground that shows you every nearby ore.
ability.kindredspirits.dragonfire.desc: Its flames sometimes catch, leaving whatever it hits burning longer.
ability.kindredspirits.kiln_breath.desc: Breathes over your pack and smelts everything in it that a furnace could.
ability.kindredspirits.eat_that.desc: Shares your meals: it heals a little whenever you eat, and you get a touch more out of the food.
ability.kindredspirits.helping_hand.desc: Now and then it slips a second copy of something you craft into your pack.
ability.kindredspirits.friendly_face.des: Villagers take a shine to you while it is near, and trade cheaper for it.
ability.kindredspirits.wisplight.desc: Leaves purple wisps of flame in dark corners near you.
ability.kindredspirits.one_with_the_nigh: You see in the dark, and the dark hides you.

screen.kindredspirits.name: Companion name
screen.kindredspirits.unbound_hint: Sneak and use the charm on a tamed spirit to bond with it. Sneak and use it again to release that bond.
jei.kindredspirits.trex_egg: Dug up from suspicious sand in desert pyramids and desert wells. Place it and it hatches into a wild T-Rex after five minutes, or half that with a torch or campfire within two blocks.
jei.kindredspirits.kindred_charm: Sneak and use the charm on a tamed spirit to bond with it. Use the charm on its own to open the bond screen, where you can summon or dismiss your companion, give it orders, set how readily it fights, and release the bond. You can only be bonded to one spirit at a time, and every charm you carry answers to that same bond. Only a bonded spirit gains levels, uses abilities and fights alongside you.
item.kindredspirits.boxing_gloves.desc: T-Rex gear. Longer reach and harder hits.
item.kindredspirits.dragon_tablet.desc: Baby Dragon gear. Calls meteors down instead of breathing fire, and makes it wander now and then.
item.kindredspirits.running_shoes.desc: Nightfox gear. Much faster, and Swift Step is twice as strong.
jei.kindredspirits.boxing_gloves: Use on your tamed T-Rex to equip. It reaches three blocks further and hits for two more damage. Use it again with another item from its gear list to swap, or take it off from the charm screen.
jei.kindredspirits.dragon_tablet: Use on your tamed Baby Dragon to equip. Its breath attack becomes a meteor that falls onto its target and scorches everything nearby. While it carries the tablet it occasionally wanders off for half a minute before coming back.
jei.kindredspirits.running_shoes: Use on your tamed Nightfox to equip. It moves 60% faster and Swift Step grants Speed II instead of Speed I.
